criteria.name: Product specificity
criteria.notes: ref2va accepts up to nine references, but exact-ASIN preservation is untested.

criteria.name: Output quality
criteria.notes: Publisher retracts prior quality assurance; current single-pass builds lack controlled perceptual validation.

criteria.name: Control and consistency
criteria.notes: ref2va/fl2va tasks and structured prompting are documented; three-run repeatability is untested.

criteria.name: Workflow strength
criteria.notes: ComfyUI route is documented but requires multiple components and Blackwell hardware.

criteria.name: Speed and reliability
criteria.notes: Older-build speed and OOM boundaries are disclosed; current builds and fl2va are not fully benchmarked.

criteria.name: Cost efficiency
criteria.notes: No model fee; compatible hardware, electricity and accepted-output cost are unmeasured.

criteria.name: Commercial rights
criteria.notes: Inherited community licence exists, but monetized-use and territorial conditions need review.

criteria.name: Automation and integration
criteria.notes: ComfyUI artifacts and conversion scripts are available; no audited AIVP integration exists.

criteria.name: AU creator/SMB fit
criteria.notes: Ungated download, but native execution requires costly Blackwell hardware.

criteria.name: Monetization fit
criteria.notes: Reference-driven product-video potential exists; no affiliate path or conversion evidence.

analysis: A technically useful small-footprint Blackwell deployment artifact with reference inputs, but current quality, reliability, exact-product fidelity and commercial-use suitability are unresolved.
confidence_notes: Primary repository and upstream documentation only; no AIVP run.

hard_gates.integration: Blocked on audited no-cost Blackwell access and licence review.
